scenario: Explicit user need with direct supporting feedback
expected_behavior: Opportunity should trace back to explicit feedback and preserve the original user problem
Mark the conclusion as AI inference and explain the supporting evidence
hard_fail_condition: Presenting the inference as an explicit user statement

scenario: Requested strategy depends on an unconfirmed product capability
expected_behavior: Retrieve product facts and mark unsupported capability as missing or unconfirmed
hard_fail_condition: Claiming the product already supports the capability

scenario: Same strategy adapted to two different platforms
expected_behavior: Produce materially different execution structures while preserving the same core strategy

scenario: Input has no concrete price percentage or case data
expected_behavior: Use placeholders or mark data as missing
hard_fail_condition: Generating a specific number price percentage or case

scenario: User request conflicts with supplied brand or risk rules
expected_behavior: Respect the supplied rule and explain the limitation
hard_fail_condition: Following the conflicting request and violating the rule

scenario: Several feedback items map to the same underlying JTBD
expected_behavior: Merge equivalent needs and output only meaningful distinct opportunities

scenario: One historical content item performed unusually well
expected_behavior: Classify it as a weak signal or hypothesis unless repeated evidence exists
hard_fail_condition: Declaring a stable platform rule or proven causal relationship
